formats.key: transferTokensWithPayload((address token,uint256 amount,uint16 targetChain,bytes32 mintRecipient) transferParams,uint32 batchId,bytes payload)
effects: Pulls exactly `transferParams.amount` of `transferParams.token` (must be a Circle-accepted token, in practice USDC) from the signer into the contract (custodyTokens → safeTransferFrom).

Burns that amount through Circle's CCTP bridge so it can be minted on the Wormhole chain `targetChain` to `mintRecipient`. Only the registered CircleIntegration contract there can complete the mint, and only when `mintRecipient` calls it.
Takes native value that must equal the Wormhole message fee (`require(msg.value == wormholeFee)`) and passes it to the Wormhole core contract.
Publishes a Wormhole message that carries the signer's address as `fromAddress` and the arbitrary `payload` for the destination application.
formats.shown: "Bridge native USDC via CCTP" with the Wormhole fee, the token, the amount with its token, the destination chain by name, the mint recipient as a raw bytes32 and the payload as raw bytes.

findings.title: transferTokensWithPayload shows the mint recipient as a raw zero-padded bytes32, not as an address.
findings.evidence: descriptor: `#.transferParams.mintRecipient` label 'Mint recipient (bytes32)' format `raw`. Case 0 shows '0x000000000000000000000000d8da6bf26964af9d7eed9e03e53415d37aa96045'. CircleIntegration.sol `_transferTokens` passes mintRecipient to depositForBurnWithCaller as the recipient on the destination chain.
findings.fix: Show `#.transferParams.mintRecipient.[12:32]` with format `addressName` (types wallet, contract) and the label 'Recipient on destination chain'.

findings.title: transferTokensWithPayload has no interpolatedIntent, so the amount, destination and recipient are missing from the glance line.
findings.evidence: descriptor: intent 'Bridge native USDC via CCTP', and no `interpolatedIntent`. The amount, targetChain and mintRecipient are only in the fields.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Bridge {#.transferParams.amount} to {#.transferParams.mintRecipient} on {#.transferParams.targetChain}'.

findings.title: transferTokensWithPayload's payload is arbitrary bytes for the destination app and cannot be decoded.
findings.evidence: CircleIntegration.sol `transferTokensWithPayload` puts `payload` into the DepositWithPayload Wormhole message. When the recipient is a contract, the payload drives what it does with the minted USDC. The descriptor shows `#.payload` raw.
findings.fix: Nothing a descriptor can decode generically. Keep the raw field.

effects: Verifies a Wormhole VAA from a registered emitter and marks it as consumed.
Requires the signer to be the encoded `mintRecipient`.
Calls Circle's MessageTransmitter.receiveMessage, which mints the bridged amount of the local Circle token (USDC) to the signer.
formats.shown: Only "Redeem USDC via Wormhole CCTP". The token, amount and source of the mint are inside encoded messages that stay hidden.

findings.title: redeemTokensWithPayload hides the minted amount and source, which sit inside the encoded VAA and Circle message.
findings.evidence: CircleIntegration.sol `redeemTokensWithPayload` decodes the amount, token and nonce from `verifiedMessage.payload` after parseAndVerifyVM. The VAA's signature count varies, so no fixed slice reaches them. Descriptor: `#.params` 'Attestation' visible never.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor today. The intent already states the incoming asset.

effects: Verifies and consumes a guardian-signed governance VAA (anyone can relay it). None of the signer's assets move.
Points the proxy to the new implementation encoded in the VAA and delegatecalls its initialize().
formats.shown: "Upgrade Circle Integration", with the governance message hidden.

findings.title: upgradeContract hides the new implementation address, which is inside the variable-length signed VAA.
findings.evidence: CircleIntegrationGovernance.sol `upgradeContract`: `readAddressFromBytes32(payload, 35)` reads from the VAA payload, whose offset depends on the number of guardian signatures. Descriptor: `#.encodedMessage` visible never.
findings.fix: No fixed slice can reach it. Nothing to change.

effects: Verifies and consumes a governance VAA, then sets the contract's Wormhole consistency level to the value encoded in the VAA. None of the signer's assets move.
formats.shown: "Update Wormhole finality", with the governance message hidden.

findings.title: updateWormholeFinality hides the new finality value, which is encoded inside the signed VAA payload.
findings.evidence: CircleIntegrationGovernance.sol `updateWormholeFinality`: `payload.toUint8(35)` sits inside the VAA. Descriptor: `#.encodedMessage` visible never.

effects: Verifies and consumes a governance VAA, then registers a foreign emitter, its chain and its Circle domain. None of the signer's assets move.
formats.shown: "Register emitter and domain", with the governance message hidden.

findings.title: registerEmitterAndDomain hides the chain, emitter and domain, which are encoded inside the signed VAA.
findings.evidence: CircleIntegrationGovernance.sol `registerEmitterAndDomain` reads emitterChainId, emitterAddress and domain from the VAA payload at offsets 35, 37 and 69. Descriptor: `#.encodedMessage` visible never.

effects: Marks the current implementation as initialized, and reverts if it already is. There is no other effect and nothing of the signer's moves.
